morocco.label: Morocco
morocco.brief: Morocco runs two coasts. On the Mediterranean, Tangier's Tanja Marina Bay -- the Kingdom's first urban marina, with 1,400 berths across two basins -- anchors the Strait, chaining east to the resort marinas of M'diq and Marina Smir near Tetouan and on to the Bay of Al-Hoceima. On the Atlantic, Marina Bouregreg sits at the mouth of the river between the twin cities of Rabat and Sale, a short run up the coast from Mohammedia and Casablanca, and far to the south the deep Agadir-Essaouira cluster completes the picture. Each coast is its own chain of short water hops; today they are all coastal road, congested through every city.
morocco.corridor_shape: Two separate coasts. Mediterranean: Tangier - M'diq/Smir - Al-Hoceima. Atlantic: Rabat/Sale - Mohammedia - Casablanca, plus the deep Agadir-Essaouira cluster to the south. No cross-strait national corridor.

tangier-morocco.name: Tangier
tangier-morocco.brief: Tangier commands the Strait of Gibraltar where the Mediterranean meets the Atlantic. Its Tanja Marina Bay is Morocco's first urban marina -- 1,400 berths across two basins in the heart of the city, Blue-Flag certified -- fronted by the Malabata beach resorts running east toward Cap Malabata. It is the western gateway of Morocco's Mediterranean coast, a short water hop from the Tetouan resort marinas.

mdiq-tetouan-morocco.name: M'diq / Tetouan
mdiq-tetouan-morocco.brief: The Tetouan coast holds Morocco's Mediterranean resort marinas -- Marina Smir and the M'diq/Kabila harbours -- a cluster of full-service marinas a short hop east of Tangier and a natural mid-point on the Strait-to-Al-Hoceima chain.

al-hoceima-morocco.name: Al-Hoceima
al-hoceima-morocco.brief: Al-Hoceima sits on a scenic bay in the Rif, with a working port and the small harbour of Cala Iris to its west. It anchors the eastern end of Morocco's Mediterranean resort coast as a compact bay cluster.

rabat-sale-morocco.name: Rabat-Sale
rabat-sale-morocco.brief: The capital's water is the Bouregreg River, where Marina Bouregreg sits at the river mouth between Rabat's historic skyline and Sale's riverfront -- sheltered from the Atlantic swell and lined with restaurants. It is the twin-city hub of the Atlantic capital coast, a short coastal run from Mohammedia and Casablanca.

mohammedia-morocco.name: Mohammedia
mohammedia-morocco.brief: Mohammedia is an Atlantic marina town between Rabat and Casablanca, a natural mid-point that turns the capital-to-economic-capital stretch into a two-hop coastal water route.
